Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.</p> <p><strong>Team Lead - Quality Assurance, Support Excellence</strong></p> <p>Quality Assurance is a vital leadership function within Customer Support, defining the operational standards for accurate, empathetic, and compliant merchant interactions. As our global footprint expands, Customer Support QA drives consistent quality across teams while establishing the strategy, vision, and operational frameworks necessary to elevate agent performance and merchant trust. Strategic AI integration is key to this transformation, moving QA from reactive audits to a continuous, AI-first model that scales across all support interactions.</p> <p>As the QA Team Lead for Customer Support, you will be part of our global Support Excellence organization, architect and execute an AI-first QA migration strategy from scratch, building evaluation models that directly improve core support metrics like CSAT, NPS, FCR, and TTR. This strategic leadership role directly manages a dedicated team of 2 QA Program Managers in Chicago, setting quality vision, defining success metrics, and embedding core evaluation dimensions, such as response accuracy, tone, empathy, issue resolution, and documentation into daily Support Operations.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define, own, and execute the global Customer Support QA strategy and vision, leading the end-to-end migrat

No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!</span></p> <p><strong>What’s next?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us.
